meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 10 — Ports and logistics densification: national seaport throughput, major gateway ports (Ho Chi Minh City / Cai Mep, Hai Phong), and logistics framing.

candidates.title: National seaport cargo and container throughput statistics
candidates.publisher: Vietnam Maritime Administration / Ministry of Construction related
candidates.description: Official statistics on total cargo throughput (million tonnes) and container throughput (TEUs) across Vietnam’s seaport system. Recent years show strong growth, with container volumes exceeding 30 million TEUs and cargo approaching or exceeding 900–960 million tonnes.

candidates.title: Ho Chi Minh City / Cai Mep port complex operational statistics
candidates.region: Southeast / Ho Chi Minh City area
candidates.description: Operational statistics for the southern gateway complex (Ho Chi Minh City Port / Cat Lai and the deep-water Cai Mep–Thi Vai cluster). Together they form Vietnam’s largest container handling concentration and rank among the world’s top container ports by volume and performance.
referenced_by: HCMC GRDP and Southeast regional analysis

candidates.title: Hai Phong port operational statistics
candidates.description: Operational statistics for Hai Phong — the principal northern gateway port. Ranks among the world’s top container ports by volume and has recorded strong performance-index gains.
referenced_by: Red River Delta and industrial-province analysis

candidates.title: National logistics and multimodal connectivity framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from maritime, transport and planning sources
candidates.description: Policy and analytical framing of Vietnam’s logistics system — seaports, inland connectivity, and the role of logistics in supporting manufacturing exports and FDI. Continuously referenced in trade-facilitation and competitiveness discussions.
referenced_by: Seaport throughput and major port nodes

candidates.title: Vietnam ports–logistics densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from maritime administration and port sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding national seaport cargo and container throughput, Ho Chi Minh City / Cai Mep port complex, Hai Phong port, and national logistics framing into a coherent maritime-logistics layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
